annotations.title: 民間学童を条件で探す

description: Find private after-school care facilities in Tokyo by ward, feature, pickup school, fee ceiling, closing time and more. Returns compact rows; fees with their conditions, pickup schools and the application route are in get_facility. null = not published by the facility (要問合せ), never 0.

fee_published.description: true = only facilities that publish a monthly fee.

holiday_care.description: true = only facilities open in school holidays.

max_monthly_fee.description: Only facilities whose published monthly floor is at or below this, in yen. Facilities that publish no fee are excluded.

open_until.description: Only facilities open until at least this time, HH:MM, e.g. 20:00.

pickup.description: true = only facilities that pick up from school.

query.description: Free text matched against name, area, operator and ward.

saturday.description: true = only facilities open on Saturdays.

school.description: Elementary school, e.g. 豊洲小 or 豊洲小学校. Returns facilities that pick up from it, and ward clubs that admit its children first (優先受入校); schoolMatch on each row says which.

subsidised.description: true = only ward-subsidised clubs (区の認証・補助); false = only the others.

tag.description: Feature tag, e.g. 英語, 学習サポート, 区の認証・補助. See list_wards.

ward.description: Ward name or slug, e.g. 世田谷区 or setagaya. See list_wards.
